justiceSays.line: 📖 Jesse is walking Jorge through a huge smooth white ball sitting on the ground, sometimes head-sized — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
📖 Jesse is walking Roman through a huge smooth white ball sitting on the ground, sometimes head-sized — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
They're named, every one: Malik Kowalski, Ellis Khan. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Malik nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
They're named, every one: Maya Okafor, Grace Ford. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Maya nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)

🔥 The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Gavel — I put it down today." "It raises the gavel-head high. The sound-block swings forward as a shield. It names your crime first — a full round before the verdict falls." "It names your crime out loud — a real thing you did. The courtroom goes quiet. The naming IS the wound." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby says "We've been walking past those." Jorge breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Harlow leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Lockpick. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Buy it off — It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase.
★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Ramps. Broad smooth leaves, onion smell. Spring only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
